title: Consolidate overlapping distribution and cold-chain logistics
rationale: Both companies operate independent perishables distribution networks in overlapping metro markets; combining cold-chain routing and warehouse capacity reduces duplicated fixed costs.

evidence.claim: Whole Foods operates approximately 431 stores concentrated in affluent urban and suburban U.S. markets.

assumptions: Combined distribution facility costs can be reduced by 10-20% within 18 months
No store closures required to realize the saving
key_risks: Perishables service-level disruption during warehouse consolidation
Union or labor-relations friction at affected distribution sites
